_comment: Cards for tests/unit/planeswalkers/test_compleated.py. `t_compleated_walker` is Tamiyo, Compleated Sage's cost and loyalty ({2}{G}{G/U/P}{U}, 5) with the keyword. `t_phyrexian_walker` is the same card without it -- the control, and the proof that paying life alone moves nothing. `t_twice_compleated` has two Phyrexian pips and loyalty 3, so paying both takes it past zero: the floor.

cards.name: Test Compleated Walker
cards.oracle_text:
Compleated ({G/U/P} can be paid with {G}, {U}, or 2 life. If life was paid, this planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.)
+1: You gain 2 life.

cards.name: Test Twice Compleated
cards.oracle_text:
Compleated ({W/P} can be paid with {W} or 2 life. For each {W/P} paid with life, this planeswalker enters with two fewer loyalty counters.)
+1: You gain 2 life.
